verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a cap table and valuation SaaS, and a natural-language command interface is a fair capability for such a product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only conventional UI workflows (issuing shares, vesting, round modeling, reports) and never mentions an AI assistant or natural-language operation. The llms.txt file describes the product to LLM crawlers; it does not let users operate the product, so it earns no credit.
